justification: A shows a monumental anthropomorphic figure with a massive head, brow ridge and low-relief incised motifs on the body (concentric circles, a belt-like band of parallel lines), while B shows a profile boat with a crew of vertical stroke-figures, an animal in profile above it, and detached limb-like marks. Beyond the generic presence of circles/discs and curved lines rendered schematically, there is no shared subject, no shared relationship between elements, and no comparable arrangement.
